correctness.rationale: The exact group enumeration covers all C(119,2)=7021 normalized unordered support pairs through 62 disjoint conjugation/rebasing orbits. The integer convolution matrix has exactly three ones in each row and every square minor has |det|<=3^60; modular ranks agree for four checked primes whose product exceeds 3^60, so all larger minors vanish over Z and a pivot-sized minor remains nonzero. This proves rank over C exactly, not heuristically. The executable checker was compiled and run successfully and validates all 35 signatures and 280840 support counts. The largest-nullity coset characterization follows by a separate count of ten order-three subgroups.

value.rationale: This is the complete natural rank invariant for every unweighted three-term convolution on the binary icosahedral (SL(2,5)) group. The intrinsic 35-signature criterion, full 280840-support census, sharp 80-dimensional coset extremizers, and unusual 22-dimensional rank-loss stratum provide useful structure beyond generic Fourier decomposition. Central extension changes the faithful spinorial contribution, so the quotient A5 rank table does not imply these values. The object is a canonical nonsolvable finite harmonic-analysis setting, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
